senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. wds.) debt, indebtedness.—בעל ח׳ (abbr. ב״ח) creditor.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 9:2">Keth. IX, 2</cite> <he>והניח … וב״ח וכ׳</he> and left a widow, a creditor (claiming a debt) and heirs.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 9:3">Ib. 3</cite> <he>וב״ח יותר על חוֹבוֹ</he> and the creditor (seized) more than his debt amounted to.
Ib. 69ᵃ בת בעלת ח׳ הויא a daughter (of a deceased father) has the privileges of a creditor, contrad. to יורשת, heiress; a. fr.—שטר ח׳ note of indebtedness.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:8">Ib. XIII, 8</cite> <he>המוציא ש׳ ח׳ וכ׳</he> if one produces a note against &c.; a. fr.—Pl. <he>חוֹבִין</he>.
